title: Ethiopian Shrimp Tibs with Dulet Sauce
description: A fusion of Ethiopian flavors with the succulence of shrimp. This dish is a twist on traditional Tibs, served with a rich Dulet sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onions and cook until translucent, 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add shrimp and cook until pink, 2-3 minutes per side.
Add dulet spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add red wine vinegar and cook until liquid is almost gone.
Stir in sour cream and cook until heated through.
Season with berbere spice blend to taste.
Serve shrimp with Dulet sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
